Mineral Gemstone Specimen Collection in Glass Plastic Display Cases Assorted
This collection features assorted mineral and gemstone specimens displayed in glass and plastic cases. Included minerals are labeled examples such as kyanite, bloodstone, goldstone, fluorite, bismuth, calcite, peridot, opal, garnet, rough emerald, snowflake obsidian, malachite, amethyst, and duffite. The stones vary in color, shape, and finish, ranging from polished to rough forms. The collection is in used but well-maintained condition and is suitable for collectors, educational use, or display. No brand or manufacturer information is available. Specimens are housed in clear plastic and glass display boxes.

278841517.description:
Natural Quartz Geode
7 lb Bulk Geode Lot
Natural Mineral Specimen
7 lbs Total Weight
Natural Unsigned Specimen
This extensive collection of natural geode specimens weighs approximately 7 pounds, featuring a variety of halved nodules that reveal intricate crystalline interiors. The specimens primarily showcase white to translucent quartz and chalcedony formations, ranging from fine-grained druzy surfaces to distinct crystalline points. The exterior matrix is composed of a natural sedimentary stone with a characteristic tan and ochre textured surface.
Multi-piece lot includes various sizes of halved and whole geode nodules
Sparkling crystalline interiors demonstrate natural geological crystallization patterns
Earthy exterior matrix remains in its natural, unpolished state
Ideal for mineral study, lapidary projects, or decorative interior displays
Condition:
Good natural condition with expected variations in crystal size and matrix texture. The specimens are unpolished and retain their natural earthy residue and irregular edges as found. The crystalline interiors are stable, though some minor shedding of loose mineral fragments may occur during handling.

278954011.description:
Natural Mineral Specimen Lot - 3 Pieces
Geode, Banded Agate, and Polished Stone
This three-piece mineral lot features a selection of geological specimens, including a crystal-lined geode and polished agate sections. These pieces represent classic mineral formations sought for display. Each specimen showcases unique natural textures, from smooth polished faces to rough, organic exteriors.
Pieces Included:
Hollow Geode: Brown rocky matrix with a crystalline druzy interior cavity; approximately 3 inches tall.
Banded Agate Slice: Translucent with concentric grey and white banding and a polished face; approximately 4.5 inches wide.
Polished Thick Slab: Dense mineral with a smooth top and a textured, porous side profile.
Condition:
Polished surfaces are smooth with no significant deep scratching. Geode crystalline interior is intact. One piece has minor adhesive tape residue on the face. No structural damage beyond natural inclusions.
